_comment: drag-lint's lint config for featuregen's own source (found first when walking up from
local-var-casing is ON with local_case = camelCase: featuregen's locals are lFoo (an 'l' prefix
then PascalCase), which the rule's own PascalCase default cannot accept. local_case only knows
PascalCase | UPPER_CASE | camelCase, not a prefix, so camelCase is the closest honest setting: it
still flags a PascalCase or UPPER_CASE local, but it cannot check the 'l' prefix itself.
NOTE: this l-prefix convention is featuregen's own; src\core, src\cli and convrules-editor use
plain PascalCase locals. Whether to rename featuregen's locals to match (about 400 names) or to
keep the convention is an open owner decision, raised at merge.
